accepted_scope: Candidate source and CPU mock-test evidence only; not production promotion or hardware/memory qualification.

verified_properties.finding: Parent retains bounded output, drains overflow, closes stdout then waits for exact child and requires exit 0 before returning JPEG envelope. No kill/terminate/timeout or process-group operations.
Dedicated fresh exec uses sys.executable and unchanged camera/default encoding arguments. cv2 import occurs only in worker; capture is released in finally.

CLI reserves a non-inheritable duplicate pipe for binary JPEG, redirects native stdout to inherited stderr before cv2 import, and closes the reserved file/descriptor through normal/error ownership paths.

Fake workers exercise normal/error release, native fd1 diagnostic separation, reserved descriptor noninheritance/closure, nonzero rejection and real waitpid reaping. Finite 256 KiB output tests draining beyond pipe capacity.

limits: TCC identity and actual camera availability/content/geometry/latency are not tested.
No actual OpenCV or camera workload ran in this review or the cited CPU suite.
Normal child exit contains child address-space retention; actual parent memory improvement is unproved.
Camera wait remains unbounded, matching the chosen existing synchronous behavior.
Arbitrary immediate/repeated KeyboardInterrupt can interrupt wait/reaping; source and README explicitly disclose this.
SOI/EOI checks are transport-envelope validation, not complete JPEG decoding.
Inherited stderr preserves existing on-disk logging behavior; it is not a disk log-size bound.
deferred_acceptance: Actual equivalent launchd/TCC camera execution and image freshness/quality.
Matched sustained parent-memory and capture-latency measurement.
Promotion only when all relevant MLX observation identities can be safely renewed.
